priorityList: Apply poisons and enter Stealth before starting combat.
Use Shadow Blades when Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are both ready and you are at low Combo Points.
Use Shadow Dance if not in stealth and you have at least 30 Energy, provided Secret Technique is ready or Darkest Night is active.
Use Vanish to enter stealth and generate Combo Points if you have 1 or fewer Combo Points and are not in Subterfuge.
Use Secret Technique as your top priority finisher during Shadow Dance or when its cooldown is nearly recovered.
Use Eviscerate as a finisher whenever the Darkest Night buff is active.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher if Secret Technique is on cooldown or Shadow Dance is active.
Use Eviscerate as your standard finisher at 6+ Combo Points (or 5+ if Darkest Night is not active).
Use Shadowstrike if Darkest Night is active and Shadow Techniques is at 5+ stacks, provided Secret Technique is not ready.
Use Shadowstrike as your primary builder while in Stealth or Shadow Dance.
Use Goremaw's Bite if you have a deficit of 3 or more Combo Points.
Use Gloomblade (or Backstab) to build Combo Points when Shadowstrike is unavailable.
Use offensive Trinkets and Racials during Shadow Blades and Shadow Dance for maximum burst.
Use a Potion when Shadow Blades is active or the fight is nearly over.
